verses.1: And Mordecai knew everything that had happened. He tore his clothes in anger. He wore a coat made of hair and wool. Then he went out into the city. He cried out loudly in pain and despair.
verses.2: And he came before the king’s gate. For it is not possible to enter the king’s gate without wearing shoes.
verses.3: And in every country and region, there is a place where the king’s words and laws are obeyed. But for the Jews, it is especially important to follow their laws and traditions. They also wear special clothes and carry certain symbols as part of their identity.
verses.4: And Esther and her maidens came forward. They told her what had happened. The queen was very upset and sent out messages to order Mordecai to remove his robe from him. But he refused to do so.
verses.5: And Esther called for Mordecai from among the king’s officials who stood before her. She commanded him to find out what this man was and why he was there.
verses.6: And he went out to Mordecai, to the part of the city that was in front of the king’s gate.
verses.7: Mardochai told him everything that had happened to him, as well as about the distribution of the money that Manas’h had ordered to be given to the Jews in order to destroy them.
verses.8: And Pashkegan was given the task of carrying out the religious decree that had been given in Shushan, so that they could be destroyed. He was given the task of seeing Esther and telling her what to do. He was also ordered to go to the king and plead with him for their people’s sake.
verses.9: And he came forward and told Esther what Mordecai had said.
verses.10: And Esther said to Hathach, and she commanded him to go to Mordecai.
verses.11: All the servants of the king, and all the people and nations under his rule, know that every man and woman who comes to see the king, to the inner courtyard where no one from their religion is allowed to enter, will be killed simply because they use gold as a weapon against the king. I am not allowed to go to see the king for thirty days.
verses.12: And they told Mordecai what Esther had said.
verses.13: And Mordecai said to Esther, “Do not be afraid in your heart, for the king’s house will not be taken away from you by all the Jews.”
verses.14: For if the heir does not take possession of it at that time, then light and darkness will stand against the Jews from another place. And you and your family will be destroyed. Who knows whether you will ever reach the kingdom at that time?
verses.15: And Esther said to Mordecai, “Return to your people.”
verses.16: Go and take care of all the Jews who are found in Susa. Do not eat or drink for three days, both night and day. I and my daughters will also do the same. Then I will go to the king, who is not righteous. And since I have died, I am indeed dead.
verses.17: And Mordecai did as Esther had commanded him.
